main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on low_close raw value (in-profile)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 with bottom-fifth mean > 0 confirms; slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, in-profile bars with raw >= 0.8

decided_by: The slope's t is +2 or more and the bottom-fifth mean next-day excess return is above 0.
reading: The falling agitated profile is read as the bars whose recorded regime is 'unknown' (the only regime with a strategy, the vetoes sending every other bar to 'chop'), the situation as an in-profile bar whose close sits below the day's high (raw value > 0) on the long side, the coin's mean daily return over all its windows' bars, every bar as a 1-bar case, and the slope's t as an OLS slope with day-clustered (per-day summed) standard error.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.006978 on the check folds against +0.01809 on every fold
